original.scope: One persistent four-thread CPU worker per graphics mode; explicit preparation, one warmup and three measured calls per batch size, alternating order. In-memory capture before timing; acquisition, caller decoding and GUI excluded. Nested timings overlap. Peak working set is cumulative per session; it does not isolate individual batch sizes. One shared workstation/scene, not general capacity or GPU qualification.
